<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>Даночка 🎀</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Pacifico&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --bg:#fff4f8;--bg2:#ffe3ee;--pink:#ff7fa8;--pink2:#ffb3cc;--lav:#d8c4ff;--peach:#ffd9c7;--ink:#6b2a47;--soft:#a2607c;
  --card:#ffffff;--dash:#ffb3cc;--shadow:rgba(255,127,168,.28);
  box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px);
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){
  --bg:#2a1020;--bg2:#3b1830;--pink:#ff8db3;--pink2:#c2587f;--lav:#7a5ab3;--peach:#8a4a58;--ink:#ffe8f1;--soft:#f0b4cb;
  --card:#3d1a31;--dash:#a8486c;--shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.35)}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{
  --bg:#2a1020;--bg2:#3b1830;--pink:#ff8db3;--pink2:#c2587f;--lav:#7a5ab3;--peach:#8a4a58;--ink:#ffe8f1;--soft:#f0b4cb;
  --card:#3d1a31;--dash:#a8486c;--shadow:rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px)}
body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);font-family:"Nunito",-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;overflow-x:hidden;
  background-color:var(--bg);
  background-image:radial-gradient(var(--pink2) 1.6px,transparent 1.8px),radial-gradient(var(--lav) 1.2px,transparent 1.4px);
  background-size:34px 34px,52px 52px;background-position:0 0,17px 22px}
body.lock{overflow:hidden;height:100%}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 8%,var(--peach),transparent 45%),radial-gradient(circle at 90% 30%,var(--lav),transparent 45%),radial-gradient(circle at 20% 95%,var(--bg2),transparent 55%);opacity:.7}
.fx{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;overflow:hidden;z-index:1}
.fx span{position:absolute;bottom:-50px;opacity:0;animation:rise linear forwards}
@keyframes rise{0%{transform:translateY(0) rotate(-10deg);opacity:0}10%{opacity:.85}100%{transform:translateY(-115vh) translateX(26px) rotate(25deg);opacity:0}}
/* lock screen */
#gate{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:50;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;
  background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--bg),var(--bg2));transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
#gate.off{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.15);pointer-events:none}
.lockbox{width:100%;max-width:360px;text-align:center;background:var(--card);border:3px dashed var(--dash);border-radius:36px;padding:34px 24px 30px;
  box-shadow:0 24px 60px var(--shadow);position:relative}
.lockbox .bow{position:absolute;top:-30px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:54px;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 10px var(--shadow))}
.lockbox h2{font-family:"Pacifico",cursive;font-weight:400;font-size:30px;margin:18px 0 6px;color:var(--pink)}
.lockbox p{margin:0 0 18px;color:var(--soft);font-size:15px}
#pw{width:100%;font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:28px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-align:center;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);
  border:3px solid var(--pink2);border-radius:20px;padding:14px;outline:none;-webkit-appearance:none}
#pw:focus{border-color:var(--pink);box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--shadow)}
#err{min-height:24px;margin:10px 0 0;color:var(--pink);font-weight:600;font-size:14px}
.shake{animation:shake .45s}
@keyframes shake{20%,60%{transform:translateX(-9px)}40%,80%{transform:translateX(9px)}}
/* buttons */
button{font:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:18px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--pink),#ff9ec0);border:0;border-radius:999px;
  padding:15px 36px;box-shadow:0 8px 0 #e85d8b,0 16px 30px var(--shadow);cursor:pointer;-webkit-appearance:none;margin-top:16px;transition:transform .1s,box-shadow .1s}
button:active{transform:translateY(6px);box-shadow:0 2px 0 #e85d8b,0 6px 14px var(--shadow)}
/* page */
main{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:560px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 22px 70px;display:none}
main.show{display:block}
.hero{min-height:92vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center}
.big{font-size:92px;line-height:1;animation:beat 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 18px var(--shadow))}
@keyframes beat{0%,100%{transform:scale(1)}15%{transform:scale(1.14)}30%{transform:scale(1)}45%{transform:scale(1.08)}}
.pill{display:inline-block;background:var(--card);border:2px dashed var(--dash);color:var(--soft);font-weight:800;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;
  text-transform:uppercase;padding:6px 16px;border-radius:999px;margin:8px 0 14px}
h1{font-family:"Pacifico",cursive;font-weight:400;font-size:74px;line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 6px;color:var(--pink);
  text-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--card),6px 6px 0 var(--pink2)}
.sub{color:var(--soft);font-size:19px;font-weight:600;margin:10px 0 0;min-height:1.7em}
.caret{display:inline-block;width:2px;height:1em;background:var(--pink);margin-left:2px;vertical-align:-2px;animation:blink 1s steps(1) infinite}
@keyframes blink{50%{opacity:0}}
.hint{margin-top:40px;color:var(--soft);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;animation:bob 2s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes bob{50%{transform:translateY(7px)}}
.divider{text-align:center;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:.4em;margin:0 0 26px}
h2.t{font-family:"Pacifico",cursive;font-weight:400;font-size:28px;line-height:1.3;margin:0 0 8px;color:var(--pink)}
.card{position:relative;background:var(--card);border:3px dashed var(--dash);border-radius:30px;padding:34px 24px 26px;margin:0 0 34px;
  box-shadow:0 14px 34px var(--shadow);opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px) rotate(-1deg);transition:opacity .9s ease,transform .9s ease}
.card:nth-of-type(even){transform:translateY(30px) rotate(1deg)}
.card.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.card::before{content:"🎀";position:absolute;top:-22px;left:22px;font-size:38px;filter:drop-shadow(0 4px 6px var(--shadow))}
.card p{margin:0}
.quote{text-align:center;font-family:"Pacifico",cursive;font-size:23px;line-height:1.6;color:var(--pink)}
/* polaroid */
.polaroid{position:relative;margin:10px auto 40px;max-width:330px;background:#fff;padding:14px 14px 56px;border-radius:12px;transform:rotate(-3deg) translateY(30px);
  box-shadow:0 20px 44px var(--shadow);opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s ease,transform 1s ease}
.polaroid.in{opacity:1;transform:rotate(-3deg)}
.polaroid img{display:block;width:100%;border-radius:6px}
.polaroid figcaption{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:12px;text-align:center;font-family:"Pacifico",cursive;font-size:22px;color:#ff7fa8}
.polaroid::before{content:"";position:absolute;top:-16px;left:50%;width:110px;height:32px;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(3deg);
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,#ffc6da,#ffc6da 8px,#ffe3ee 8px,#ffe3ee 16px);opacity:.92;border-radius:4px}
.polaroid::after{content:"💗";position:absolute;right:-12px;bottom:-14px;font-size:36px;animation:beat 1.6s ease-in-out infinite}
/* chips */
.chips{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin:0 0 34px}
.chip{background:var(--card);border:3px solid var(--pink2);border-radius:26px;padding:20px 10px;text-align:center;font-weight:800;color:var(--soft);
  box-shadow:0 8px 0 var(--pink2);opacity:0;transform:translateY(24px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.chip.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.chip b{display:block;font-size:38px;margin-bottom:2px;font-weight:400;animation:bounce 2.6s ease-in-out infinite}
.chip:nth-child(2) b{animation-delay:-.6s}.chip:nth-child(3) b{animation-delay:-1.2s}.chip:nth-child(4) b{animation-delay:-1.8s}
@keyframes bounce{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0)}50%{transform:translateY(-8px) rotate(6deg)}}
.finale{text-align:center;padding-top:10px}
.finale p{margin:0;color:var(--soft);font-weight:600}
#love{font-family:"Pacifico",cursive;font-size:46px;line-height:1.3;margin-top:28px;color:var(--pink);text-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--card),5px 5px 0 var(--pink2);
  opacity:0;transform:scale(.6) rotate(-6deg);transition:all 1s cubic-bezier(.2,1.5,.4,1)}
#love.on{opacity:1;transform:none}
#love small{font-family:"Nunito",sans-serif;font-weight:600;font-size:16px;text-shadow:none;color:var(--soft);letter-spacing:.04em}
footer{text-align:center;color:var(--soft);font-weight:600;font-size:14px;margin-top:44px}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{animation:none!important}.card,.chip,.polaroid{opacity:1}}
</style>
</head>
<body class="lock">
<div class="fx" id="fx" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<div id="gate">
  <div class="lockbox" id="box">
    <div class="bow">🎀</div>
    <h2>Только для Даночки</h2>
    <p>Введи дату наших отношений (месяц, день, год), чтобы открыть сюрприз</p>
    <input id="pw" type="text" inputmode="numeric" autocomplete="off" placeholder="ММ.ДД.ГГ" maxlength="10" aria-label="Дата наших отношений">
    <div id="err"></div>
    <button id="open">Открыть 💌</button>
  </div>
</div>

<main id="main">
  <section class="hero">
    <div class="big">💖</div>
    <span class="pill">только для тебя</span>
    <h1>Даночка</h1>
    <p class="sub"><span id="type"></span><span class="caret"></span></p>
    <div class="hint">листай вниз ↓</div>
  </section>

  <div class="divider">🌸 🎀 🌸</div>

  <figure class="polaroid"><img alt="Даночка" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,

---
